//: TODO(design): working texts and numbers written by Claude (M2c); change them freely. What lies in the underground besides terrain: thresholds between rings, places (landmarks, biome locations, rare places), remains, hoards, echoes, conditions and run modifiers. Numbers of how many and where are in balance.json undergroundGenerator.

thresholds.//: Ways through the rock bands between rings (GAME_DESIGN.md §9.3). hidden: looks like rock until the hydra stands next to it, and a draught gives it away (hint). dig: opened by digging, one dig per turn, it takes `turns` digs (a range: each threshold gets its own). open: opened with one action by a head of class `headClass` (heads.json). alwaysOpen: open from the start. rareChance: the threshold is a rare place, in a world with this chance (0–1).

draughtCrack.name: Draught Crack
draughtCrack.text: A crack in the rock, and air moving through it. Just wide enough, if all the heads breathe in at once. They do not agree on when.
draughtCrack.hint: A draught. The rock nearby is breathing.

rubbleChoke.name: Rubble Choke
rubbleChoke.text: A tunnel, and then a great deal of rock where the tunnel used to be.

dig.label: Dig through the rubble.
dig.progress: You dig until your claws ache. The rubble shifts, sulks, and stays.

rootWall.name: Root Wall
rootWall.text: Roots as thick as a man's leg have grown across the tunnel, and refuse to discuss it.

saltPlug.name: Salt Plug
saltPlug.text: A plug of white salt seals the tunnel. Someone began carving a saint into it, then thought better of the face.

smoulderingSeam.name: Smouldering Seam
smoulderingSeam.text: A seam of coal has been smouldering here for a century. The Order lists it as a minor miracle.

cinderScar.name: Cinder Scar
cinderScar.text: A tunnel with glassy walls, melted through the rock long ago. Still warm. Something very small and very hot came this way, in very large numbers.

oldWorkings.name: Old Workings
oldWorkings.text: An old shaft of the Order, cut dead straight through the rock with no regard for anyone's feelings.

places.//: landmark: one for each main biome of a ring, always, seen from afar. location: 1–2 per biome, from its pool. rare: in a world with `chance` (0–1); where: chamber (of ring `ring`) or deadEnd. echo: the line heard before the place is seen. actions: what the hydra can do there. An action can: cost movement (movementCost), need a head class (headClass), be done once (once) or every few turns (cooldownTurns), give resources (gain), put a condition on the hydra (condition, from conditions below), carry the hydra along a current (carry), show one hidden threshold (revealHiddenThreshold). result: what is said after. silencesBattlesWithin: battles this many hexes away or closer don't raise the Alert.

sunkenOak.name: The Sunken Oak
sunkenOak.text: A whole oak fell through the ceiling and landed upside down. It has gone on growing, out of spite.

drownedChapel.name: The Drowned Chapel
drownedChapel.text: A chapel of the Order, drowned up to its bell tower. The bell still hangs there, waiting for a congregation that breathes water.

ossuaryCathedral.name: The Ossuary Cathedral
ossuaryCathedral.text: A cathedral with chandeliers of bone. The founders of the Order, arranged by height.

saltSaint.name: The Salt Saint
saltSaint.text: A huge salt statue of a miner, licked to a shine. Nobody knows by whom. Several heads look guilty.

motherCap.name: The Mother Cap
motherCap.text: A mushroom whose cap is the ceiling of the cave. The light under it is purple and very patient.

undertow.name: Undertow
undertow.text: Under the black water, a current runs somewhere with more conviction than anything else down here.
undertow.echo: Water moves somewhere ahead, with purpose.

actions.label: Let the current take you.
actions.result: The current takes you home. Roughly.

gallowsRoots.name: Gallows Roots
gallowsRoots.text: The Order's gallows tree grew roots down here. The roots kept what the tree dropped: the bones of heretics, filed neatly.
gallowsRoots.echo: Somewhere ahead, wood creaks under a weight that is no longer there.

actions.label: Take the bones.
actions.result: The heretics don't object. Nobody asked them the first time either.

brineLake.name: Brine Lake
brineLake.text: A still lake of brine, white at the edges. It tastes of tears and old pickles.
brineLake.echo: You smell salt and still water.

actions.label: Drink.
actions.result: Refreshing, the way a slap is refreshing. Your hide stiffens with salt.

ninefoldCamp.name: Ninefold Camp
ninefoldCamp.text: A camp of the Ninefold, cultists who believe the hydra is holy. They have made you a banner. The spelling is creative.
ninefoldCamp.echo: Someone ahead is singing in nine parts. Badly.

actions.label: Accept their gifts.
actions.result: They bring what they have and sing in nine parts. The heads are flattered and pretend not to be.

myceliumWhisper.name: Mycelium Whisper
myceliumWhisper.text: The floor here is one great web of mycelium. Lay a head on it, and it listens on your behalf.

actions.label: Put a head to the mycelium.
actions.result: The underground hums into one ear. Every footstep of the Order, counted and filed.

silentBell.name: The Silent Bell
silentBell.text: A resonator of the Hushed, overgrown with fungus. It hums too low to hear. Nearby, fighting makes no sound the Order can hear.
silentBell.echo: A hum, too low to hear. Your teeth hear it.

lostSurvey.name: The Lost Survey
lostSurvey.text: A whole survey party of the Order, still holding its instruments. Their last report is very precise about being lost.

actions.label: Take their map.
actions.result: The map is wrong everywhere but one place: a crack in the rock nobody was meant to find.

hushedStair.name: The Hushed Stair
hushedStair.text: Stairs going down into the dark, behind a door with no handle on this side. The stone hums when the Serpent speaks.
hushedStair.echo: Below you, something like a staircase is breathing.

remains.//: Remains in dead ends: loot is one of these resources, picked at random, in this range. lines: one is shown when the hydra finds the remains; "any" can be found anywhere, a biome's lines only in that biome.

any: A brother of the Order. He died waiting for permission to retreat.
Three surveyors and one map. The map is wrong.
A torchbearer whose torch went out first. He is holding it up anyway.
A tax collector of the Order. The ledger survived him. So did the debts.
Someone who came down to see if the hydra was real.
A novice with a list of sins to confess. Item four: went into the caves.
A knight in very good armour. It held. He did not.
An inquisitor of the Order, mid-sentence.
floodedCaves: A drowned priest, still holding his breath on principle.
A lantern-bearer, swollen with water. The lantern is fine.
rootTangle: A woodcutter who came down after a root. The root won.
A pilgrim caught in the roots, like a fly in a very slow web.
oldCrypts: A grave robber, sharing a niche with the saint he came to rob. They seem to get on.
A crypt-keeper, filed under the wrong saint.
saltMines: A miner, preserved in salt. He looks better than he did alive.
A cart driver of the salt mines, and his cart, and his receipts.
fungalDeeps: Something that was a man, under a coat of soft grey fungus. It looks content.
An alchemist who came for the mushrooms and stayed.

guardedHoard.name: A hoard
guardedHoard.text: Somebody piled up supplies here and left a guard. The guard was the easy part.

patchFinds.//: What a patch (a chamber in another ring's biome) holds when its biome has no location left for it: remains (with the biome's lines), richDeposit or shrine.

echoes.//: Lines heard at the edge of the known map, giving away the biome of a patch around the corner. Places have their own echo.
echoes.floodedCaves: Water drips somewhere ahead, very patiently.
echoes.rootTangle: Roots creak ahead, like an old house settling.
echoes.saltMines: The air ahead turns dry and tastes of tears.

conditions.//: Conditions on the hydra that last a few turns. movement: change of movement points per turn. revealsEncounters: every encounter on the map is shown.

salted.name: Salted
salted.text: Salt dries the hide stiff. One move fewer each turn.

myceliumWhisper.name: Mycelium Whisper
myceliumWhisper.text: The mycelium tells you where the Order is.

runModifiers.//: Modifiers that change the world (GAME_DESIGN.md §9.6). For now they are turned on with the URL parameter ?modifiers=wetYear,oldWorkings. waterShareBonus: share of water added in biomes that have water. moistureMultiplier: more Moisture sources. extraFungalPatches: patches of fungalBiome added to each ring where it is not the main biome. extraEncounters: encounters along the shaft.

wetYear.name: Wet Year
wetYear.text: A wet year. Water seeps into everything, including morale.

myceliumBloom.name: Mycelium Bloom
myceliumBloom.text: The mycelium is blooming. Fungus turns up where it has no business, which is everywhere.

oldWorkings.name: Old Workings
oldWorkings.text: An old shaft of the Order cuts straight through the outer rings. The Order still uses it, out of habit.
